test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a code language, 'MOBILE' is written as ‘8$2%£@’, ‘DRAPE’ is written as ‘9#+▪@’ and ‘CRUEL’ is written as ‘6#3@£’. How will 'CRAMP' be written in that language?
solution:
The pattern followed here is as follows:

'MOBILE' is written as ‘8$2%£@’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd5b6cdddeb43173ebc00620c61e9cddaf38fd6296f5f88c2858608c46a384f2.png] 

‘DRAPE’ is written as ‘9#+▪@’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70d0a2b0cbaa31239fb8b29f2cedf45536c88fe755057ef222329f1cef7590ba.png] 

‘CRUEL’ is written as ‘6#3@£’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a202dd8519e10112a009964c2f0f7b8f34b2a2bbd41171202bfdda8d012dfbe0.png] 

Similarly, 'CRAMP' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e924da2382ce66672e893ef9c31f887874db78759d6fb3614e67989cb9e5382.png] 

Hence,** 'option 3'** is the correct answer.
